objective: Create a comprehensive catalog and data model for status effects used in combat, including schema, data models, tests, and integration points.
prerequisites: Scan Assets/Scripts/ for combat and effect pipelines

steps.title: Enumerate Effects
steps.description: Create master list with id, displayName, description, stacking rules, duration semantics, tags, and type.

steps.title: Define Data Schema
steps.description: Add or extend assets/docs/schemas/status-effects.schema.json with fields for stacking, duration, effects array, and source whitelist.

steps.title: Implement C# Data Models
steps.description: Create ScriptableObject StatusEffectDefinition under Assets/Scripts/DataModels/ with inspector-friendly fields.

steps.title: Integrate with Combat Pipeline
steps.description: Wire StatusEffectManager to apply, tick, and expire effects; add telemetry hooks.

steps.title: Unit Tests
steps.description: Add Unity Test Framework tests for stacking, duration, expiry, and interactions.

steps.title: Examples & Migration
steps.description: Add example JSON files and migration notes; include sample ScriptableObjects.
